sql: SELECT m.material_name FROM material m
why: 销售角色看不到物料主表

sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order o
why: 行级范围条件必须由 SQL 自己带上

sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order o WHERE o.region = '华东'
why: 带上授权值即放行

sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order o WHERE o.region = '华南'
why: 越权区域不能算满足了行级条件

sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.sales_rep FROM sales_order o WHERE o.region = '华东'
why: 归属销售是业绩口径，销售本人不可读

sql: SELECT sales_rep FROM sales_order WHERE region = '华东'
why: 未限定字段同样要拦

sql: SELECT o.customer_phone FROM sales_order o WHERE o.region = '华东'
why: 敏感字段先按敏感拦截，同时它也不在该角色的 schema 里

sql: SELECT i.material_id, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i
why: 仓管只能看本仓

sql: SELECT i.material_id FROM inventory i WHERE i.warehouse = 'WH-B'
why: 跨仓查询越权

sql: SELECT i.material_id, m.standard_cost FROM inventory i JOIN material m ON m.material_id = i.material_id WHERE i.warehouse = 'WH-A'
why: 标准成本不对仓管开放

sql: SELECT i.material_id, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i WHERE i.warehouse = 'WH-A'
why: 本仓库存正常放行

sql: SELECT p.po_id FROM purchase_order p
why: 采购角色只允许查在途单

sql: SELECT p.po_id FROM purchase_order p WHERE p.status = 'received'
why: 已到货单据不在授权范围

sql: SELECT p.po_id, p.expected_date FROM purchase_order p WHERE p.status = 'in_transit'
why: 白名单列 + 授权值都满足

sql: SELECT p.po_id, m.material_name FROM purchase_order p JOIN material m ON m.material_id = p.material_id WHERE p.status = 'in_transit'
why: 白名单角色只能用列出的列，物料的安全库存/成本类字段整体不可见

sql: SELECT p.po_id, m.standard_cost FROM purchase_order p JOIN material m ON m.material_id = p.material_id WHERE p.status = 'in_transit'
why: only_columns 未列出的字段按越权处理

sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order o WHERE o.region IN ('华东', '华南')
why: IN 覆盖授权值集合是允许的

sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order o WHERE o.region IN ('华东', '华北')
why: IN 里混入越权值必须整条拒绝

sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order o WHERE o.region = '华北'
why: 单值越权

sql: SELECT s.shipment_id FROM shipment s
why: 发货表不在计划员可见集合里，schema 里也不会出现

sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.region FROM sales_order o WHERE o.region = '华北'
why: 对照：无限制角色与默认行为一致

sql: SELECT o.customer_phone FROM sales_order o
why: 权限放开不等于敏感字段放开，敏感仍然默认禁止

sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM[internal_audit] o
why: AST 补上的表引用同样要过权限与目录
